title: Softened crossing covers give an eventual 4.89253 N gate lower bound

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. claims: For every simple cubic graph on n vertices, if all prefixes of a vertex ordering have softened anchor cost at most M at penalty 1/2, then its edge cutwidth is at most M + o(n), uniformly over graphs and anchor orderings.

For every simple cubic graph on n vertices and penalty lambda in [3/8, 1], if all prefixes of a vertex ordering have softened anchor cost at most M, then its edge cutwidth is at most R(lambda) M + o(n) uniformly, where R(lambda) = 1 + 9 (1 - 2 lambda)_+^2 / (16 lambda (3 - 2 lambda)) and R(35/71) = 80089/80080.

experiments.purpose: Enclose the alternating crossing-path sum, verify all scalar bounds, replay the four local gain integrals, and compare the resulting width with the declared gate coefficient by exact fractions.
